name: Eventin Addon for Elementor
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Eventin Addon for Elementor extends the power of Eventin by adding beautiful, drag-and-drop widgets for event calendars, online ticket sales, event registration, speaker profiles, and more.

Easily design and customize every section of your event website visually inside Elementor, no coding required.

Whether you’re organizing conferences, workshops, webinars, community meetups, or corporate training sessions, this addon helps you build stunning event pages and drive more registrations with interactive, conversion-focused layouts.

Key Features

  • Elementor Integration: Convert all Eventin shortcodes into drag-and-drop Elementor widgets
  • Easy Customization: Style every widget directly from Elementor’s visual interface
  • Responsive Design: All widgets are fully responsive and look great on any device
  • No Coding Required: Build professional event pages without writing a single line of code
  • Real-time Preview: See your design changes instantly with Elementor’s live preview
  • Professional Templates: Access to ready-made widget templates designed for events

Widgets Included

  • Event Calendar (Month, Week, List views)
  • Event Grid & List Display
  • Event Registration & RSVP Form
  • Ticket Listing & Purchase Widget
  • Speaker Profile Cards
  • Event Schedule / Agenda
  • Event Countdown Timer
  • Event Location Map
  • Event Categories Filter

Who Is This For?

This addon is perfect for anyone building event websites with Elementor and Eventin:

  • Event Planners & Organizers – Showcase upcoming events, sell tickets, and collect registrations – all designed visually in Elementor.
  • Conference & Summit Organizers – Build multi-session schedules, speaker lineups, and ticket tiers with pixel-perfect control.
  • Online Tutors & eLearning Creators – Display live classes, webinars, and workshop schedules alongside your course listings.
  • Webinar & Virtual Event Hosts – Create compelling landing pages for online events with Zoom or Google Meet links embedded seamlessly.
  • Meetup & Community Hosts – Set up RSVP event pages with attendee capacity indicators and location maps.
  • Corporate Trainers – Design structured training program pages with session schedules and registration forms.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate Eventin + Elementor + this addon
  2. Open any page in Elementor’s editor
  3. Search for “Eventin” in the widget panel
  4. Drag your chosen widget onto the page
  5. Customize colors, fonts, layouts, and content in real-time
  6. Publish — your event page is live!

Seamless Integration

This addon works hand-in-hand with:

  • Eventin – The core event management plugin (required)
  • Elementor – The drag-and-drop page builder (required)

Go Further with Eventin Pro

The free version of Eventin gives you everything you need to get started. Eventin Pro unlocks advanced tools for growing event businesses:

  • AI Event Creator – Generate full event descriptions, FAQs, tags, and banners in under 10 seconds
  • Ticket Template Builder – Design fully branded, custom PDF event tickets
  • Advanced Analytics – Track registrations, ticket sales, and attendee data
  • Recurring Events – Schedule daily, weekly, monthly, or custom repeat events
  • Landing Page Builder – Design dedicated event landing pages with pre-built templates
  • Multi-language Support – Reach global audiences with full translation support

👉 Upgrade to Eventin Pro

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need Eventin and Elementor installed for this addon to work?

Yes. Both Eventin and Elementor must be installed and activated for this addon to work correctly.

Is this Eventin Elementor addon free?

Yes, the Eventin Elementor Addon is completely free. Some advanced widget options tied to Eventin Pro features require an Eventin Pro license.

Will the widgets work with my existing Elementor theme?

Yes. The widgets are designed to work with any Elementor-compatible WordPress theme. They inherit your theme’s typography and color settings, and you can customize everything further from within Elementor.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. This addon is built specifically so that event organizers can design professional pages without any coding knowledge.

Can I use these widgets with the free version of Eventin?

Yes! All core widgets (Event Calendar, Registration Form, Ticket Listings, Speaker Cards, etc.) work with the free version of Eventin. Widgets that display Pro features require Eventin Pro.

Is it compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes. This addon is tested and compatible with WordPress 6.9 and the latest version of Elementor.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eventin-elementor-addon directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure both Eventin and Elementor plugins are installed and activated.
  4. Open any page in Elementor and search for “Eventin” in the widget panel.
  5. Drag your chosen widget onto the page and start customizing!
